deployment-runs: Create, run and inspect deployment runs.
deployment-runs add-item: Add an item to a deployment run.
deployment-runs approve: Approve the run's current human approval stage.
deployment-runs carried-work: Repair the record of work a run carried.
deployment-runs carried-work repair: Recompute a run's carried work that was never compared.
deployment-runs create: Create a deployment run from a flow, without starting it.
deployment-runs execute: Run or resume a deployment run.
deployment-runs execution: Read facts about how a deployment run executes.
deployment-runs execution containment-ba: Read which changes a deployment run's release contains.
deployment-runs failure-trace: Trace a failed run to the GitHub job that failed.
deployment-runs find-by-item: Find deployment runs that include an item.
deployment-runs get: Show a deployment run and its members.
deployment-runs project-snapshot: Copy a deployment run snapshot file into this server.
deployment-runs release-output: Record commits a run's own automation wrote.
deployment-runs release-output record: Record a commit this run's own automation wrote.
deployment-runs remove-item: Take an item out of a deployment run, with a reason.
deployment-runs resolve-target: Show the environment a flow would deploy to.
deployment-runs stage-approval: Check approvals on deployment run stages.
deployment-runs stage-approval evaluate: Check whether a run stage's approval is satisfied.
deployment-runs stages: List a deployment run's stages and their state.
deployment-runs start-for-item: Open a delivery run for one item.
deployment-runs terminalize: Close an active run as failed or cancelled.
deployment-runs timings: Show how long each release step of a run took.
deployment-runs update: Set one field on a deployment run.
deployment-runs validate-composition: Check which items a deployment run would include.
